Ui.Script:
local ZOOM_MAX = 4 local ZOOM_STEP = 1.25 local ICON_SLOTS = 40
local zoom = 1 local pan = nil local iconsDirty = false local lastContinent, lastZone, lastInfo
local detail = WorldMapDetailFrame local baseWidth = detail:GetWidth() local baseHeight = detail:GetHeight() local view = CreateFrame("ScrollFrame", "WorldMapZoomFrame", WorldMapFrame)
do local level = detail:GetFrameLevel() local points = {} for i = 1, detail:GetNumPoints() do points[i] = { detail:GetPoint(i) } end view:SetScale(detail:GetScale()) view:SetWidth(baseWidth) view:SetHeight(baseHeight) for i = 1, table.getn(points) do local p = points[i] view:SetPoint(p[1], p[2], p[3], p[4], p[5]) end if level > 0 then view:SetFrameLevel(level - 1) end detail:ClearAllPoints() detail:SetParent(view) detail:SetScale(1) view:SetScrollChild(detail) detail:SetFrameLevel(level) view:EnableMouseWheel(true) view:Show() end
-- A slot per frame that rides on the map: landmarks, unit blips, the corpse. local function BenillaZoom_Icons() local icons = {} for i = 1, NUM_WORLDMAP_POIS or 0 do table.insert(icons, getglobal("WorldMapFramePOI" .. i)) end table.insert(icons, WorldMapPlayer) for i = 1, 4 do table.insert(icons, getglobal("WorldMapParty" .. i)) end for i = 1, ICON_SLOTS do table.insert(icons, getglobal("WorldMapRaid" .. i)) end for i = 1, 2 do table.insert(icons, getglobal("WorldMapFlag" .. i)) end table.insert(icons, WorldMapCorpse) table.insert(icons, WorldMapDeathRelease) return icons end
-- Scale 1 / zoom and the anchor offset times the zoom, so the icon's centre stays on its map -- point at its 1x size. The stock code rewrites the offsets unscaled; an offset that is not -- the one written here is the new 1x base. local function BenillaZoom_Seat(icon) local point, relativeTo, relativePoint, x, y = icon:GetPoint(1) if not point then return end local baseX, baseY = x, y if icon.benillaOutX and math.abs(x - icon.benillaOutX) < 0.01 and math.abs(y - icon.benillaOutY) < 0.01 then baseX, baseY = icon.benillaBaseX, icon.benillaBaseY end local outX, outY = baseX * zoom, baseY * zoom icon:SetScale(1 / zoom) if outX ~= x or outY ~= y then icon:SetPoint(point, relativeTo, relativePoint, outX, outY) end icon.benillaBaseX, icon.benillaBaseY = baseX, baseY icon.benillaOutX, icon.benillaOutY = outX, outY end
function BenillaMapZoom_SeatIcons() if zoom == 1 and not iconsDirty then return end iconsDirty = false local icons = BenillaZoom_Icons() for i = 1, table.getn(icons) do BenillaZoom_Seat(icons[i]) end end
local function BenillaZoom_Clamp(x, y) local effective = detail:GetEffectiveScale() local viewEffective = view:GetEffectiveScale() local overX = (baseWidth * effective - view:GetWidth() * viewEffective) / effective local overY = (baseHeight * effective - view:GetHeight() * viewEffective) / effective x = math.min(0, math.max(-overX, x)) y = math.max(0, math.min(overY, y)) return x, y end
local function BenillaZoom_SetOffsets(x, y) x, y = BenillaZoom_Clamp(x, y) view:SetHorizontalScroll(x) view:SetVerticalScroll(y) end
function BenillaMapZoom_GetZoom() return zoom end
function BenillaMapZoom_Reset() pan = nil if zoom ~= 1 then zoom = 1 detail:SetScale(1) iconsDirty = true end view:SetHorizontalScroll(0) view:SetVerticalScroll(0) WorldMapButton:RegisterForDrag() BenillaMapZoom_SeatIcons() end
-- The map under the cursor, as WorldMapButton_OnUpdate computes it. local function BenillaZoom_CursorUV(cx, cy) local scale = WorldMapButton:GetEffectiveScale() local centerX, centerY = WorldMapButton:GetCenter() local width = WorldMapButton:GetWidth() local height = WorldMapButton:GetHeight() return (cx / scale - (centerX - width / 2)) / width, ((centerY + height / 2) - cy / scale) / height end
-- Sets the zoom so the map point under (cx, cy) stays under it. local function BenillaZoom_SetZoom(newZoom, cx, cy) local viewEffective = view:GetEffectiveScale() local oldEffective = detail:GetEffectiveScale() local newEffective = viewEffective * newZoom local left = detail:GetLeft() * oldEffective local top = detail:GetTop() * oldEffective local u = (cx - left) / (baseWidth * oldEffective) local v = (top - cy) / (baseHeight * oldEffective) local viewLeft = view:GetLeft() * viewEffective local viewTop = view:GetTop() * viewEffective
zoom = newZoom if zoom < 1.0001 then zoom = 1 end detail:SetScale(zoom) iconsDirty = true newEffective = viewEffective * zoom BenillaZoom_SetOffsets( (cx - u * baseWidth * newEffective - viewLeft) / newEffective, (cy + v * baseHeight * newEffective - viewTop) / newEffective) if zoom > 1 then WorldMapButton:RegisterForDrag("LeftButton") else pan = nil WorldMapButton:RegisterForDrag() end BenillaMapZoom_SeatIcons() end
function BenillaMapZoom_OnMouseWheel(delta) local cx, cy = GetCursorPosition() if delta < 0 then if zoom == 1 then WorldMapZoomOutButton_OnClick() BenillaMapZoom_Sync() else BenillaZoom_SetZoom(math.max(1, zoom / ZOOM_STEP), cx, cy) end return end if zoom == 1 and GetCurrentMapZone() == 0 and GetCurrentMapContinent() >= 0 then local u, v = BenillaZoom_CursorUV(cx, cy) local _, file = UpdateMapHighlight(u, v) if file then ProcessMapClick(u, v) BenillaMapZoom_Sync() return end end BenillaZoom_SetZoom(math.min(ZOOM_MAX, zoom * ZOOM_STEP), cx, cy) end
function BenillaMapZoom_DragStart() if zoom <= 1 then return end local cx, cy = GetCursorPosition() pan = { cx = cx, cy = cy, x = view:GetHorizontalScroll(), y = view:GetVerticalScroll(), } end
function BenillaMapZoom_DragStop() pan = nil end
function BenillaMapZoom_Pan() if not pan then return end local cx, cy = GetCursorPosition() local effective = detail:GetEffectiveScale() BenillaZoom_SetOffsets(pan.x + (cx - pan.cx) / effective, pan.y + (cy - pan.cy) / effective) end
-- A change of the shown map puts the view back at 1x. function BenillaMapZoom_Sync() local continent, zone, info = GetCurrentMapContinent(), GetCurrentMapZone(), GetMapInfo() if continent ~= lastContinent or zone ~= lastZone or info ~= lastInfo then lastContinent, lastZone, lastInfo = continent, zone, info BenillaMapZoom_Reset() end end
view:SetScript("OnMouseWheel", function() BenillaMapZoom_OnMouseWheel(arg1) end) view:SetScript("OnShow", function() lastContinent, lastZone, lastInfo = GetCurrentMapContinent(), GetCurrentMapZone(), GetMapInfo() BenillaMapZoom_Reset() end) view:SetScript("OnUpdate", function() BenillaMapZoom_Pan() BenillaMapZoom_Sync() end) WorldMapButton:SetScript("OnDragStart", BenillaMapZoom_DragStart) WorldMapButton:SetScript("OnDragStop", BenillaMapZoom_DragStop)
local BenillaZoom_OldUpdate = WorldMapFrame_Update function WorldMapFrame_Update() BenillaZoom_OldUpdate() BenillaMapZoom_Sync() iconsDirty = true BenillaMapZoom_SeatIcons() end
-- The stock update seats the unit blips every frame at 1x offsets. local BenillaZoom_OldButtonUpdate = WorldMapButton_OnUpdate function WorldMapButton_OnUpdate(elapsed) BenillaMapZoom_Pan() BenillaZoom_OldButtonUpdate(elapsed) BenillaMapZoom_SeatIcons() end
